verdict.rationale: Streaming live session audio out to an external service is a fair question for a video API, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented feature that streams live session audio to a transcription or realtime model endpoint. The nearest items are SIP interconnect to SIP gateways and archiving (recording, not a live stream), which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running
